## objective

Exclude secondary (0x100) records from every metric in sam-tagger, per the
2026-11-18 design agreement. Supplementary (0x800) records stay in all
metrics. Annotate still writes skipped records to its output BAM.

## scope

- `src/sam_tagger/lib.py`: secondary guard in the four record loops
  (annotate, error-stats, pileup, qc-summary); annotate writes the record
  before skipping; the length-dist gate simplifies to supplementary-only.
- `src/sam_tagger/stats/length_dist.py`: docstring reword.
- `src/sam_tagger/cli.py`: qc-summary docstring gains the exclusion sentence.
- `docs/usage.qmd`: depth-universe/parity sentence (divergence shrinks to
  0x200/0x400), strand-counts sentence, length-dist paragraph.
- `tests/`: update the two pinned tests; add one end-to-end exclusion test
  (error-stats + pileup + annotate pass-through).
- Version bump 0.9.0 in `pyproject.toml`, `pixi.toml`, `__init__.py`.

## what happened

1. Wrote this plan, then added the four guards and the docstring edits.
2. Updated the pinned strand/length-dist tests and added the new test.
3. First suite run used bare `pixi run test`, which resolves pytest from
   the global pixi bin (default env declares no pytest) — all 13 files
   failed at collection. `pixi run which pytest` located the cause; the
   correct invocation is `pixi run -e dev test`.
4. Two test-expectation misses (pileup emits one row per position; FL
   stats zero-fill every header reference) fixed after reading failures.
5. Reworded `usage.qmd`; bumped 0.9.0; refreshed the default env.
6. Gates in the dev env: 171 tests passed, ruff clean, pyright 0 errors.

## risks

- Semantic change to published outputs (`total_reads` etc. drop wherever
  multi-mappers exist) — accepted by design; released as `feat!`.
- Annotate output BAM stays record-complete; secondary records pass
  through untagged (0.8.x tagged them).

## verification

- `pixi run -e dev test` → 171 passed (updated + new tests).
- The samtools-parity test passes unchanged (its fixture has no
  secondary records).
- The new test asserts annotate writes secondary records through untagged.
